input.prompt: Edit the first image, a realistic, moody photograph taken from bed at first light: a dark-oak nightstand with one drawer, a single glass of water, a brass lamp that is switched off, linen curtains glowing with low morning sun, deep shadows, a white duvet in the foreground. Keep everything about it exactly the same: camera, composition, the low warm light and deep shadow, film grain, every object. Make only this change: stand the real product from the second image, the white tub with a green lid ('nutrilite begin Daily GI primer'), upright on the nightstand top beside the glass of water, label facing the viewer, at a realistic size for a 255 g tub. Match its shape, lid colour and label artwork as closely as possible. Light it exactly like the room: warm low sun from the window catching one side, the rest falling into the same soft shadow, with a real contact shadow on the wood, so it looks photographed in this room, not pasted in. Photorealistic, not a 3D render. No hands, no person, no other new objects.
